newsitem.title: USA: Neoprobe revises Q3 net loss to $0.31/shr.
newsitem.headline: Neoprobe revises Q3 net loss to $0.31/shr.

text.p: Neoprobe Corp said Friday it would revise its third-quarter results downward, due to a decision to defer the recognition of $2 million which had been previously recognized as income during the third quarter.
The restatement increases the company's net loss for the quarter ended Sept 30, 1996, to $6.2 million from $4.2 million and for the nine month period to $14.2 million from $12.2 million.

The amended net loss per share for the respective periods is $0.31 per share for the quarter compared to a net loss of $0.21 per share. For the year-to-date figures, the amended net loss is $0.74 per share compared to the previous $0.64 loss per share, the company said.
